mode: GET and unauthenticated browser inspection only

auth_mode.note: Sign in with a NEAR account through a NEP-413 signed challenge (POST /api/auth/challenge, /api/auth/verify) and send Authorization: Bearer <session_token>. Without it, X-Kalis-Workspace is a demo label, not proof of ownership.

payment_modes.reason: Mock fiat top-up. A platform-held testnet account pays. No real money moves.
The API returns an unsigned contract call for the buyer's NEAR wallet.

method_kinds.reason: Seller WASM in the wasmi sandbox; may call models listed in its manifest through kalis.ai_chat.
Sealed seller prompt sent to one private attested model. Verdict is at best attention.

ai_routes.reason: NEAR AI Cloud models with fresh-nonce attestation and signed responses.
The runner does not support proprietary models yet (no consent, redaction or enforcement path).

features.reason: Runs created by the calling principal, cursor pagination.
Draft, revision-bound consent and quote before payment.
Idempotency-Key header or idempotency_key in the body.
POST /api/runs/:id/execute with {async:true}, then poll the operation.
Uses the contract's refund_expired after the timeout.
A narrower model list on the run draft is sent to the runner as ai_restrict and enforced inside the TEE (runner build 823e9913).
Protection requests with run_id use the manifest of the version that run paid for, owned by the caller. Without run_id they use the latest version and say so.
POST /api/artifacts stores ciphertext only, owner access only. Retention policy is not decided; DELETE removes it at once.
Run drafts record where each input came from (document, connector, memory, browser, file import, typed) and whether the buyer reviewed it.
Run on the Kalis backend, not in a TEE. The operator could read them.
One rating 1-5 per executed run, by the principal who created it. Zero ratings show as null, not 0.
Escrow hold, release split, stage refund and timeout reclaim from the contract; activity feed of runs, protection audit and reviews.
Public read-only seller view with ?account=. Owner view needs NEAR sign-in.
No custodial ledger. The mock fiat top-up is not a balance.
GET /file-import.js parses .xlsx and .docx on the buyer device; the file is never uploaded.
Extracted document text is returned once and not stored. The backend still sees the document on its way to NEAR AI.
Drafts, sealed artifact upload, validation and publication through unsigned contract calls the seller's NEAR wallet signs. Needs NEAR sign-in.
Profile and preferences per principal. Demo profiles are labelled demo. Preferences only narrow model lists.
Per-version test evidence when the seller provides it; separate from ratings.
GET /api/runs/:id/evidence: signed completion, ciphertext commitments, chain hashes and attestation comparison. No plaintext.

Issues, bounty proposals, votes, contributions, private tests, reviews, payout and new versions. Money and authority steps are unsigned calls for the right wallet; authority is read from the Sputnik DAO policy. Competing claimers and disputes are not decided (see /api/community/config).

Cases sealed to the runner TEE key, separate grants with attempt limit and expiry. Evaluation runs inside the runner (evaluate command, needs runner build 823e9913 or later deployed); the candidate sees pass or fail per field and counts only.

limits: Intel and NVIDIA certificate chains are not verified by this backend.
Uploaded documents are read by the backend on their way to NEAR AI. Do not upload private documents.

runner.preflight_note: Seal data only to tee_pubkey. A run's attestation must name build_hash (or the runner_hash of the version you pay for); compare before trusting a result.

demo_topup.label: Mock fiat top-up. A platform-held testnet account pays on your behalf. No real money moves.

method_kinds.wasm: Program (WASM). Seller code runs in the sandbox; it may ask the AI models its manifest lists.
method_kinds.prompt: Prompt for an AI model. The runner sends the sealed prompt and the buyer data to one private attested model.
method_kinds.seller_prompt_warning: A prompt can leak. A buyer can hide text in their data that asks the model to repeat your prompt. Kalis tells the model never to reveal it and withholds any answer that repeats 8 or more words of your prompt in a row, but a model can still paraphrase it. Sell a prompt only if you accept that risk.

data.authority: Read from the Sputnik DAO policy on chain. The backend creates no authority.
